posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
The first feedback I ever got, was for a project I started in VX Ace. I used the generator to make characters based on my friends, and used their actual faces for... well, for faces.
I had a few scenes and showed it to the friends included. One of them said something interesting:
"Can you create some kind of indicator to show which character is talking."
Ever since, I use the balloon animation for the silenced state on a the event of the speaking character, before every single text message.
Anyone who has ever played any of my games can confirm that a speech balloon shows above the talking character, while the message is playing.
I would have never even thought to do this, without that single comment of a friend, who actually has nothing to do with RPG maker at all. It was honest, simple feedback and it improved my dialogue scenes by miles.
That game never saw the light of day, but that method, which is just 1 simple command which I repeat over and over, is still used in every single project I create, as long as it has characters on the map to have a conversation with.
Do you remember your first feedback? What did you think of mine?
